task.description:
Validate that DSL-04 meets all MUST acceptance criteria and is ready for release. Read the requirement at docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md (DSL-04 around line 1924). Read the test report from artifacts_in. Run:

1. Verify zig build exits 0
2. Verify zig build test exits 0 with all DSL-04 tests passing
3. Verify the error set check passes (zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set")
4. Confirm all acceptance criteria from the requirement are met:
   - Each type has a literal form (where applicable) and round-trips through parse then evaluate
   - Attempting to use an unsupported type produces a structured parse error
5. Check benchmark env if applicable
6. Produce a release decision file at docs/status/release-DSL-04-<date>.json
acceptance_criteria: All DSL-04 acceptance criteria confirmed met

result.summary: Release APPROVED for DSL-04 (Stage 7 — Expression DSL). All validations passed: zig build and zig build test exit 0, no error set issues, all 46 tests pass (17 DSL-04 specific). Both acceptance criteria confirmed: each supported type (null, bool, int64, float64, string, timestamp) round-trips through parse-evaluate, and unsupported types produce structured parse errors. Release decision written to docs/status/release-DSL-04-2026-05-27.json.

issues.description: Benchmark environment (zig build bench) requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL which is not configured. This does not block DSL-04 release as NFR thresholds are platform-level (engine/event system), not DSL-type-system specific.

result.next_action: Route to DOC-UPDATER to set DSL-04 requirement status to RELEASED
